reviewer: independent second_photos_b agent; no authoring changes to advanced questions
scope: Independent complete read of all 28 questions, full model answers, key points, criteria, analysis, limits and source notes, compared with every cited fact in the existing source-reviewed course dataset. No project files edited.

checks.advancedDepth: pass: every question requires application, comparison, counterfactual/causal reasoning, evidence evaluation or a developed ethical analysis; none is a simple fact-recall question relabeled as advanced.
checks.fullAnswers: pass: complete coherent answers of 202–229 words; their checkpoints supplement the prose rather than substitute for it.
checks.sourceAlignment: pass: all cited facts are present and aligned with the linked source sections; pedagogical scenarios and deductions are identified as such.
checks.newUnsupportedContent: none found: no new examination domain, drug receptor/psilocin mechanism, unsupported experimental result, invented significance estimate or contemporary medical/legal claim.
checks.fungalCycles: pass: plasmogamy is distinct from karyogamy, n + n is distinct from 2n, meiosis and the typical basidial ordering are correct and source-bound; general book chronology is not imposed on every fungal group.
checks.slimeMolds: pass: plasmodial slime molds are placed in Amoebozoa rather than Fungi; amoeboid/flagellate forms are alternatives, syngamy produces a diploid zygote, mitotic nuclear division produces the multinucleate diploid plasmodium, and meiosis restores haploid spores in the illustrated sexual model.
checks.historicalClassification: pass: algsvampar is treated as a historical catch-all, Aphanomyces astaci as an oomycete outside Fungi, Rhizopus as a true fungal example and yeast/mold as growth habits, with no invented exact identity for unnamed source images.
checks.filmSubstanceAndCondition: pass: MDMA/PTSD, psilocybin/depression and cancer-associated depression/death anxiety remain separate; MDMA risks/resources are not reassigned to psilocybin.
checks.filmStatistics: pass: two-thirds refers to the film’s MDMA two-month endpoint; 30/60 refers to reported shares of participants with improvement, not individual symptom percent reduction; arithmetic is explicitly approximate and no unsupported exact control numbers are added.
checks.filmMechanismAndEvidence: pass: 7200 connections are treated as the film’s equal-total redistributed diagrams; MRI and metaphors do not prove permanent cure or exclude placebo; acute experience does not establish diagnosis or long-term outcome.
checks.filmRiskAndEthics: pass: three suicide attempts are unresolved safety signals, not established causal events or a calculated rate; consent, fairness, support and resource priorities are explicitly normative or proposed assessments.
checks.historical2022Context: pass: film questions retain 2022 source framing and do not assert present approvals, law, clinical practice or fulfilled forecasts.
checks.gradingClaim: A-nivå is a pedagogical quality objective; this content review does not certify a teacher’s grade.
